def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator row or column.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len(set(row[c] for row in grid)) == 1), None)
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)

    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
        fill = min(common)
        return [[3 if a == b else fill
                 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
                for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]

    top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    common = set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
    fill = min(common)
    return [[3 if a == b else fill for a, b in zip(trow, brow)]
            for trow, brow in zip(top, bottom)]
